title: Cleaning Service Equipment Inspection Report Form
subtitle: Control site preparation, cleaning, disinfection, inspection, and secure handoff through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete cleaning service equipment inspection report for rooms, surfaces, fixtures, chemicals, tools, and controlled items. It connects cleaning plan, product label, safety data, and site instructions to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a trained cleaning technician or team lead must inspect rooms, surfaces, fixtures, chemicals, tools, and controlled items against stated criteria and issue a traceable condition, restriction, corrective-action, or release decision.

sections.title: Cleaning Service inspection scope, criteria, and readiness

blocks.label: Inspection access and control readiness

sections.title: Cleaning Service equipment inspection report closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This cleaning service equipment inspection report is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when chemical identity, compatibility, dilution, ventilation, exposure, biohazard, sharps, security, or occupied-area control is uncertain. A cleaning, chemical-safety, or site supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
